name: crew
description: A resident product team in Claude Code: a PM splits your PRD into features and acceptance criteria, QA writes a test case for each, a tech lead breaks them into tasks, and a full-stack agent builds the tasks on crew's own git branch and worktree. Gaps and product questions come back to you. The board is held to the PRD as it stands, checked every few seconds. Memory lives in the repo. Run it with /crew or by asking Claude. Work in progress: PM, QA, tech lead and full-stack today.
